correctness.rationale: Every feasible velocity admits precisely one cycle-current degree of freedom. Differentiating its entropy production gives a strictly positive curvature and a unique minimizer. A three-term hyperbolic-tangent identity proves the exact conservative cases. The analytic odd-power expansion yields the cubic coefficient, and a monotone scalar-root compact-bracketing argument proves the high-drive limit. The packaged checker passed 5,007 independent deterministic numerical assertions, supplementary to the proof. Finite numerical sampling is not treated as a proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete, natural parameter classification of when conservative control remains exactly optimal in the smallest cyclic Markov network. The sector sign rule prevents chirality reversal at arbitrary forcing amplitude and the strong-drive formula supplies an observable, direction-resolved saturation value not determined by the published global bound. Those are physically motivated structural consequences, not just a numerical sample or renaming of the existing Euler condition.
